reviews.title: Native Lock pro by Urban company
reviews.body: It's a beautiful lock with all the functionality. Loved the features and camera viewing angle n quality is also very nice. Installation was also smooth and free of cost. Bought for my 85mm thick door.

reviews.author: Madhav
reviews.title: Good Device with Scope for Improvement in Video Recording, Face Unlock and Customer Support
reviews.body: The device is good overall, but it would be excellent if it included a video recording feature with at least seven days of recording storage and playback. The face unlock feature also needs improvement, as its performance is not very satisfactory. Most importantly, I would strongly urge UC to provide a toll-free customer care number to ensure quick resolution of customer issues. Reliable and easily accessible customer support would significantly improve the overall user experience and customer satisfaction.
